title.tr: Beton zeminde metal ayaklı, yüksek arkalıklı kahverengi köşe bank
title.en: Brown corner bench on metal legs with a high back on a concrete floor

alt.tr: Beton zeminde ince metal ayaklar üzerinde yükselen, dikey tahtalı yüksek arkalıklı kahverengi ahşap köşe bank
alt.en: A brown-varnished timber corner bench raised on thin metal legs on a concrete floor, with a tall back of vertical boards

caption.tr: Bankın sırtlığı dikey tahtalarla yapılmış ve oldukça yüksek. Metal ayaklar oturağı zeminden ayırıp hafif gösteriyor.
caption.en: The back of the bench is made of vertical boards and is quite tall. The metal legs lift the seat off the ground and make it look light.
